messages:
morgan: starting a config-only rollout to prod for routing weights + batching/timeouts. change window 22:00-23:00 PT. canary -> 1%
deploy-bot: deploy queued: deploy_id=deploy-1789998888, mode=config-only, target=prod, canary=1%
priya: ack. @jordan oncall? :eyes:
jordan: here. will watch SLOs and errors. subscribed #incidents for alerts.
alex: can someone paste the diff? want a quick look before canary.
morgan: paste config diff:
```json
{
  "routing": {"priority_policy":"latency-first", "weights":{"stable":99, "tweak":1}},
  "batching": {"max_batch_tokens":4096, "max_batch_size":64, "window_ms":12},
  "timeouts": {"head":1200, "stream_idle_ms":30000}
}
```
sam: canary launched
obs-bot: canary traffic 1% routed to tweak variant. metrics (canary): p50=48ms, p95=178ms, p99=320ms, 5xx=0.0%
morgan: watching for 10m, blameless postmortem if anything odd.
...10m later...
jordan: FYI tenant acme-inc p99 jumped to 420ms since canary start, small sample but visible in tracing.
priya: hmm. no 5xx but tail latency is concerning for a few tenants. do we rollback or tweak?
alex: my guess is batching window_ms=12 is letting large requests accumulate; try reducing window or max_batch_size.
morgan: agree. plan: pause ramp, keep canary at 1%, push a config-hotfix reducing max_batch_size->48 and window_ms->8, then re-evaluate.
priya: please include rollback command in the patch notes.
deploy-bot: reminder: to revert you can run `/deploy rollback deploy-1789998888` or apply previous config hash.
morgan: applying hotfix: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"max_batch_size":48,"window_ms":8}}' --to prod --canary 1%'`
deploy-bot: hotfix started: patch_id=patch-1790000001, status=canarying
obs-bot: hotfix canary metrics: p50=46ms, p95=160ms, p99(acme-inc)=190ms, 5xx=0.0%
morgan: much better. recommending ramp to 25% now.
deploy-bot: ramping traffic to 25% for patch-1790000001
obs-bot: 25% metrics stable after 7m. p95 slightly down, p99 normalized. no 5xx observed.
priya: note for release notes: applied config-only change (batching.window_ms 12->8, batching.max_batch_size 64->48, routing.priority set to latency-first with small variant weight). change window closed at 22:45 PT.
morgan: pinning this config to model-variant v12.1 for 24h as precaution.
jordan: monitoring extended for 6h. rollback criteria: tenant 5xx > 0.5% OR p99 delta > +200ms sustained for 5m.
alex: adding short playbook to the deploy ticket with rollback steps + owner (priya).
sam: thanks — nice quick iteration. closing thread unless alerts fire. :thumbsup:
